purpose: Prevent unlike transmission-capacity quantities from being displayed as if they were equivalent.

definitions.definition: The nominal power rating of an HVDC converter or the project's stated design transfer quantity.
definitions.warning: May exceed contracted delivery, accredited capacity, available transfer capability, or an interface limit.

definitions.definition: A conductor thermal or design capability under stated assumptions.
definitions.warning: Substations, series compensation, voltage, stability, protection, or contingency criteria may bind first.

definitions.definition: A limiting rating of terminal, converter, transformer, series-compensation, or other corridor equipment.
definitions.warning: The most restrictive applicable system element or contingency governs actual operation.

definitions.definition: A stated nominal ability to transfer power over a line or interface.
definitions.warning: Actual operation may be lower and direction- or season-dependent.

definitions.definition: An import quantity used in a dated system-operator planning or market study.
definitions.warning: It is a study-case assumption, not a real-time operating limit.

definitions.definition: An import quantity eligible for capacity treatment in a dated system-operator study.
definitions.warning: Can differ sharply from energy capability; zero does not mean the line carries no energy.

definitions.definition: A contractual or tariff-based firm transmission-service right between specified points.
definitions.warning: A service right is not a physical conductor rating and may coexist with other rights and reliability reservations.

definitions.definition: A market right to deliver a stated quantity of capacity across a constrained interface.
definitions.warning: A market-right quantity is not the same as an engineering rating.

definitions.definition: The maximum quantity described in a permit or environmental-review configuration that may include later phases.
definitions.warning: Not proof that all phases are financed, built, or in service.

definitions.definition: A nonsimultaneous directional maximum specified by a permit.
definitions.warning: Northbound and southbound maxima cannot be added and are not simultaneously available.

prohibited_transforms: Do not infer MW from kV.
Do not infer annual TWh from MW without an independently sourced utilization or delivery profile.
Do not add opposite-direction nonsimultaneous limits.
Do not add phased ultimate capacity to current phase capacity.
Do not label a market right or capacity accreditation as a conductor rating.
Do not treat available transfer capability as fixed; it changes with outages, reservations, generation, load, topology, and reliability criteria.
